terra.problem: The explanation repeats that Jesus prayed a third time and says counting matters because the text counts. It is flat and circular.
The explanation repeats that Jesus said the same thing without adding a clear insight. It feels generic and padded.
It reverses Jesus’ words: He tells the disciples to rise before saying His betrayer is approaching, not afterward.
The handshake-and-cookie joke makes the armed arrival to arrest Jesus into a punchline, rather than finding a lighter detail outside the serious act.
The passage does not identify the crowd as shepherds, but it does not establish that no shepherds were present.
The passage does not identify the crowd as tax collectors, but it does not establish that no tax collectors were present.
The passage records Jesus telling the companion to put the sword back. It does not say that the companion did so.
The disciples’ flight does not come right after the arrest. The sword incident and Jesus’ words intervene.
